description: Rename a file in the artist's Library, give it a short description, set the artist's own tags, link it to one song or album, or say what it is and whether Audora may use it in their films, as the file's Edit in the Library does. Only what you pass changes; tags replaces the whole set. It overwrites what was there (the answer says what it was), so tell the artist what you change. Limits: name 120 characters, description 500, up to 20 tags of 40 characters, stored lowercase.

album_id.description: Link it to this album (from list_albums). Clears a song link.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

description.description: A few words about it; null clears it.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the change happens once.

in_films.description: May Audora cut it into the films it makes for the artist's releases. false is final. Ask the artist; never guess it for them.

name.description: The file's name; null goes back to its own name.

tags.description: The artist's own tags, the whole set; [] clears them.

track_id.description: Link it to this song (from list_tracks). Clears an album link.

unlink.description: true: take it off its song or album.

what_it_is.description: What the file is, in the artist's words: playing (or singing), on_stage, studio, music_video, on_the_way (behind the scenes, places), portrait (a photo of them or the band), talking (to the camera), finished_post (already edited, words or effects on it), artwork (cover, poster). null when not sure. Given alone, in_films takes the kind's default (off for talking, finished_post, artwork).

name: update_media
title: Organize a Library file
